authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W05-W17 with trustworthy W17 telemetry/evidence accepted
defaults.mission: Governed evaluation and adaptation: model/prompt/profile registry, golden datasets, confidence calibration, shadow strategies, template promotion, adaptive router optimizer and quality x latency x cost Economic Governor.

tasks.title: W18-00 - Evals/Learning Coordination & Promotion Governance Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W17 telemetry/evidence quality before any adaptive claim.
2. Freeze registry/eval/promotion ownership and Observation -> Eval -> Candidate -> SHADOW -> CANARY -> LearningPromotionRecord -> rollback flow.
3. Define datasets, holdouts, success/safety metrics and rollback criteria.
4. Define no-online-self-promotion invariant.
5. Create premortem for reward hacking, biased datasets, silent regressions and economic runaway.
tasks.forbidden: Do not modify authority semantics or permit ungated production self-learning.

tasks.title: W18-A - Model / Prompt / Profile Registry & Compatibility
actions: 1. Create versioned registry for model/prompt/agent-profile/strategy configurations.
2. Track compatibility, provenance, status and rollout phase.
3. Support reproducible evaluation references.
4. Separate capability/strategy availability from authority.
5. Add registry/version tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not duplicate W04 Capability Registry.

tasks.title: W18-B - Golden Datasets & Regression Gates
actions: 1. Build versioned golden/benchmark datasets from synthetic, historical and evidence-derived cases with provenance/privacy controls.
2. Define train/eval/holdout separation where applicable.
3. Cover correctness, safety, cost/latency and failure scenarios.
4. Create regression gates for known task classes.
5. Add dataset drift/version integrity checks.
tasks.forbidden: Do not leak secrets/personal runtime data into fixtures.

tasks.title: W18-C - Confidence Calibration
actions: 1. Evaluate confidence against observed correctness/uncertainty by task class.
2. Implement calibration metrics and abstention/escalation thresholds.
3. Detect overconfidence and distribution drift.
4. Use confidence only for routing/verification strategy.
5. Prove confidence cannot elevate authority.
tasks.forbidden: No permission/spend/action authority from calibrated confidence.

tasks.title: W18-D - Shadow Strategy Comparison
actions: 1. Run candidate strategies in SHADOW against production-like observations without side effects.
2. Compare quality, latency, cost, tool/model calls and safety.
3. Use W17 StrategyExecutionRecord for matched analysis.
4. Define statistical/minimum-evidence criteria and stop conditions.
5. Add leakage/side-effect prohibition tests.
tasks.forbidden: Shadow candidates must not execute external writes.

tasks.title: W18-E - PlanTemplate Learning Candidate Generation
actions: 1. Mine repeated successful task/plan patterns from evidence.
2. Generate candidate PlanTemplate/PlanBinding improvements under W04-compatible schema.
3. Record source observations, support count, context constraints and risk class.
4. Reject candidates with insufficient evidence or authority assumptions.
5. Add candidate reproducibility tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not directly modify active W04 templates.

tasks.title: W18-F - Validated TemplatePromotionRecord & Rollback
actions: 1. Define promotion record for evaluated templates/strategies with evidence, scope, version, rollout phase and rollback.
2. Require evaluation thresholds and safety gates.
3. Support SHADOW/CANARY/LIMITED/GENERAL/RETIRED-style governed lifecycle as accepted.
4. Implement rollback and supersession.
5. Add failed-canary/rollback tests.
tasks.forbidden: No direct online promotion from usage signal alone.

tasks.title: W18-G - Adaptive Model / Strategy Router Optimizer
actions: 1. Optimize routing based on evidence by task class, complexity, risk, latency and cost.
2. Respect hard safety/authority constraints and minimum quality.
3. Support exploration only within governed shadow/canary bounds.
4. Fall back to known safe route on uncertainty/drift.
5. Add adversarial/economic-runaway tests.
tasks.forbidden: Optimizer cannot select a path that bypasses mandatory safety stages.

tasks.title: W18-H - Economic Governor
actions: 1. Implement quality x latency x cost objective/budget evaluation.
2. Use bounded compute/tool/model/retrieval budgets and business-value context.
3. Define graceful degradation/abstention/escalation.
4. Measure coordination overhead and avoid over-agentification.
5. Add budget exhaustion/fan-out tests.
tasks.forbidden: Cost reduction cannot reduce authority/evidence completeness.

tasks.title: W18-I - Learning Promotion Governance, Canary & Acceptance
actions: 1. Integrate registry/datasets/calibration/shadow/template/router/economic governance.
2. Run canary promotion and rollback drills.
3. Test dataset drift, stale telemetry, reward hacking, unsafe strategy and economic runaway.
4. Run four Risk Gates/exact-head CI.
5. Publish governed W18 handoff; no unbounded self-adaptation.
tasks.forbidden: Do not auto-promote or mutate authority/policy.
